+import { createServerFn } from '@tanstack/react-start'
+import { z } from 'zod'
+import { addToCart, checkout, getAnalytics, getCart, getPrompt, getStorefront, removeFromCart, toggleFavorite } from './db'
+
+const filtersSchema = z.object({ q: z.string().optional(), model: z.string().optional(), category: z.string().optional(), sort: z.enum(['Featured', 'Newest', 'Popular']).optional(), favorites: z.boolean().optional(), freeOnly: z.boolean().optional() })
+const idSchema = z.object({ id: z.string().min(1) })
+
+export const loadStorefront = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' }).validator((data) => filtersSchema.parse(data ?? {})).handler(({ data }) => getStorefront(data))
+export const loadPrompt = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' }).validator((data) => idSchema.parse(data)).handler(({ data }) => getPrompt(data.id))
+export const loadCart = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' }).handler(() => getCart())
+export const loadAnalytics = createServerFn({ method: 'GET' }).handler(() => getAnalytics())
+export const favoritePrompt = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' }).validator((data) => idSchema.parse(data)).handler(({ data }) => toggleFavorite(data.id))
+export const cartPrompt = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' }).validator((data) => idSchema.parse(data)).handler(({ data }) => addToCart(data.id))
+export const uncartPrompt = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' }).validator((data) => idSchema.parse(data)).handler(({ data }) => removeFromCart(data.id))
+export const checkoutCart = createServerFn({ method: 'POST' }).handler(() => checkout())
*** Add File: src/server/api.ts
+export { addToCart, checkout, getAnalytics, getCart, getPrompt, getStorefront, removeFromCart, toggleFavorite } from './db'
+
+export const marketplaceApi = { getStorefront, getPrompt, getCart, getAnalytics, toggleFavorite, addToCart, removeFromCart, checkout }
+
+import { addToCart, checkout, getAnalytics, getCart, getPrompt, getStorefront, removeFromCart, toggleFavorite } from './db'
*** End Patch
